title: Rava Upma with Peanuts
subtitle: A quick semolina upma, roasted golden and studded with peanuts.
protein: ~14–16g protein per adult serving (peanuts are the primary source)

method.title: Dry roast rava and peanuts
items: Heat a wide pan on medium; add rava {1 cup} — dry roast 3–4 min, stirring constantly until lightly golden and fragrant
In the same pan, dry roast peanuts {⅓ cup} on medium 3–4 min until skins blister; set aside

method.title: Tempering
items: Heat ghee {2 tbsp} in the pan on medium
Add mustard seeds {1 tsp} — splutter; add cumin seeds {½ tsp}
Add hing {¼ tsp}, curry leaves {8–10}, cashews {10–12} if using — stir 30 sec
Add capsicum {½ cup} and tomato {1 medium}; cook 2 min
Add turmeric {¼ tsp} and salt {to taste}; stir

method.label: Toddler — pull portion here (before chili)
items: Scoop out the cooked vegetables {3–4 tbsp} into a separate small pan now — before adding green chili to the main pan
Add water {¼ cup} and roasted rava {3 tbsp} to her pan; cook on low, stirring until soft and water absorbed
Stir in crushed peanuts {1 tsp} or a drop of ghee
Optional: add finely diced boiled potato for extra bulk

method.title: Add chili and cook upma
items: Add green chili {1–2} to the adult pan; cook 20 sec
Bring water {2½ cups} to a boil in a separate pot; pour into the tempering pan carefully
Reduce heat to medium-low; slowly add remaining roasted rava {rest of the 1 cup} while stirring continuously to avoid lumps
Stir in remaining roasted peanuts {rest of the ⅓ cup}
Cover and cook 3–4 min on low until rava absorbs all water
Finish with lemon juice {1 tsp} and coriander {2 tbsp}

method.label: Tip
method.text: Roasting rava before cooking is non-negotiable — it prevents lumpy upma. Add water slowly and stir constantly as it goes in.
